{
  "vision": "Transform the existing Hive-based data warehouse into a modern, high-performance Delta Lakehouse on Databricks to deliver ACID-compliant, unified batch and streaming analytics with improved data reliability, faster queries, and seamless BI integration.",
  "scope": "The migration covers 500+ Hive tables (200 TB), 150 Airflow ETL jobs, 50 BI dashboards, and real-time streams. Key features include Delta Lake ACID transactions, time travel, schema evolution, and query optimization via Z-ordering. Backward compatibility and zero dashboard downtime are mandatory.",
  "success_criteria": [
    "Complete migration within 8 weeks with phased rollout",
    "Achieve 50% query time reduction for top 20 queries",
    "Maintain dashboard availability with zero downtime",
    "Reduce storage footprint by 30% through compaction and Z-ordering",
    "Stay within $80,000/month compute budget",
    "Full governance enabled via Unity Catalog"
  ],
  "user_stories": [
    {
      "id": "US-001",
      "title": "Migrate existing Hive tables to Delta format with backward-compatible schema",
      "as_a": "data engineer",
      "i_want": "to convert all Hive tables to Delta Lake tables ensuring backward-compatible SQL queries",
      "so_that": "existing BI dashboards and ETL jobs continue to run seamlessly during and after migration",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "a Hive table with existing schema", "when": "I convert it to Delta format using Databricks utilities", "then": "the table should retain schema and support existing SELECT queries without modification"},
        {"given": "running dashboards on Tableau or Looker", "when": "data is migrated to Delta format", "then": "dashboards should continue to refresh without errors or downtime"}
      ],
      "priority": "High",
      "story_points": 8,
      "labels": ["migration", "delta-lake", "compatibility"]
    },
    {
      "id": "US-002",
      "title": "Implement ACID transactions to ensure data consistency during concurrent writes",
      "as_a": "data engineer",
      "i_want": "to enable ACID transactions on Delta tables",
      "so_that": "data consistency issues caused by concurrent writes are eliminated",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "multiple ETL jobs writing to the same table", "when": "Delta Lake transaction logs handle the writes", "then": "data integrity should be maintained without conflicting records or corruption"},
        {"given": "real-time streaming ingestion", "when": "updates occur concurrently", "then": "Delta tables should maintain correct versioned data without missing or duplicated entries"}
      ],
      "priority": "High",
      "story_points": 5,
      "labels": ["acid", "data-consistency"]
    },
    {
      "id": "US-003",
      "title": "Enable time travel on Delta tables with 30-day retention",
      "as_a": "data analyst",
      "i_want": "to query historical versions of Delta tables using time travel",
      "so_that": "I can audit and compare previous data states within the last 30 days",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "a Delta table with version history", "when": "I execute a query with a timestamp parameter", "then": "the system should return the data snapshot as it existed at that time"},
        {"given": "policy configuration for time travel retention", "when": "data exceeds 30 days", "then": "older snapshots should be purged according to retention rules"}
      ],
      "priority": "Medium",
      "story_points": 3,
      "labels": ["time-travel", "data-versioning"]
    },
    {
      "id": "US-004",
      "title": "Optimize top 20 queries with Z-ordering and automatic compaction",
      "as_a": "data engineer",
      "i_want": "to implement Z-order indexing on frequently queried columns",
      "so_that": "query performance improves by at least 50% for the top dashboards and reports",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "High-volume Delta tables", "when": "Z-ordering is applied to relevant query columns", "then": "query execution time should reduce by at least 50%"},
        {"given": "ongoing data ingestion", "when": "automatic compaction runs", "then": "table storage usage should reduce by approximately 30%"}
      ],
      "priority": "High",
      "story_points": 8,
      "labels": ["performance", "optimization"]
    },
    {
      "id": "US-005",
      "title": "Integrate Unity Catalog for centralized access control and lineage tracking",
      "as_a": "data governance admin",
      "i_want": "to register all Delta tables in Unity Catalog",
      "so_that": "data access policies, lineage, and audit capabilities are unified across the platform",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "a registered Delta table", "when": "users query it via Databricks or BI tools", "then": "access should be controlled based on Unity Catalog permissions"},
        {"given": "an ETL job writing data", "when": "lineage tracking is enabled", "then": "Unity Catalog should log source-to-target relationships automatically"}
      ],
      "priority": "Medium",
      "story_points": 5,
      "labels": ["governance", "unity-catalog"]
    },
    {
      "id": "US-006",
      "title": "Support unified batch and streaming processing for real-time analytics",
      "as_a": "data engineer",
      "i_want": "to configure Delta Lake for both batch and streaming ETL workloads",
      "so_that": "the architecture supports real-time operational analytics and historical data seamlessly",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "an incoming Kafka stream", "when": "it writes data into Delta table", "then": "data should appear in the same table accessible through batch queries"},
        {"given": "batch ETL processes", "when": "they update or compact data", "then": "streaming queries should continue without interruption"}
      ],
      "priority": "High",
      "story_points": 8,
      "labels": ["streaming", "batch", "delta"]
    },
    {
      "id": "US-007",
      "title": "Conduct Delta Lake training workshops for data engineering team",
      "as_a": "project manager",
      "i_want": "to schedule and deliver two hands-on workshops on Delta Lake patterns and optimization",
      "so_that": "data engineers gain knowledge and best practices for operating and maintaining the new architecture",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        {"given": "a training plan and materials", "when": "workshops are completed", "then": "at least 90% of engineers should report improved confidence in managing Delta Lake workflows"},
        {"given": "post-training assessment", "when": "engineers take the evaluation", "then": "average score should exceed 80%"}
      ],
      "priority": "Medium",
      "story_points": 3,
      "labels": ["training", "enablement", "delta-lake"]
    }
  ]
}

{
  "sprint_goal": "Migrate core Hive tables to Delta Lake with ACID transactions and schema compatibility, laying foundation for unified lakehouse architecture.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Assess existing Hive table schemas and dependencies",
      "description": "Analyze 500+ Hive tables to document schema details, dependencies, and BI connections for compatibility validation prior to Delta conversion.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Convert high-priority Hive tables to Delta format",
      "description": "Use Databricks utilities to convert top 50 Hive tables to Delta format ensuring backward-compatible schema and support for existing SQL queries.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 12.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Validate dashboard connectivity post migration",
      "description": "Test Tableau and Looker dashboards against newly migrated Delta tables to confirm zero downtime and data consistency.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Implement ACID transactions on Delta tables",
      "description": "Configure Delta transaction logs and validate concurrent write scenarios across ETL jobs to ensure consistent records and integrity.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Enable time travel with 30-day retention policy",
      "description": "Activate Delta Lake time travel settings and configure retention period for historical version snapshots, verifying rollback and audit queries.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 3.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Implement Z-ordering and auto compaction for performance",
      "description": "Apply Z-order indexing on top 20 query columns and enable Delta automatic compaction policies to improve query performance and storage efficiency.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Register migrated tables in Unity Catalog",
      "description": "Integrate Delta tables into Unity Catalog to enforce centralized access controls, lineage tracking, and permission audits.",
      "category": "Security",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "Dashboard downtime during table migration may impact business reporting.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Implement shadow tables and switch dashboards post verification without interrupting refresh cycles."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "ETL jobs might fail due to schema mismatches after conversion.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Perform pre-migration schema validation and regression testing before full rollout."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "Query performance gains may not meet 50% target due to suboptimal Z-order columns.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Conduct profiling to identify columns with highest filter frequency and fine-tune Z-order strategy."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Access policies may break if Unity Catalog integration is misconfigured.",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Pilot with test users and validate permissions before global rollout."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "All high-priority Hive tables converted to Delta format successfully",
    "No dashboard downtime or errors during migration",
    "ACID transactions validated for concurrent ETL workloads",
    "Time travel retention confirmed at 30 days",
    "Query performance improvement of at least 50% verified",
    "Unity Catalog registration completed for migrated tables",
    "All tasks reviewed and tested in staging environment"
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 40.0
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a hybrid testing strategy combining automated API testing (using Jest + Supertest), data validation in Databricks notebooks (PyTest and SQL assertions), and performance benchmarking using Spark metrics. For ETL and streaming validation, integrate with Airflow DAG test suites using pytest-airflow. Governance and security tests will use Databricks REST API mock verification and permission validation in Unity Catalog. All tests will run in CI/CD pipelines with dedicated staging environment mirroring AWS Databricks Runtime 13.3 LTS.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Verify Hive to Delta table conversion retains schema and backward compatibility",
      "description": "Ensure schema consistency and query compatibility after converting a Hive table to Delta format using Databricks conversion utility.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Databricks workspace accessible", "Hive table with known schema exists", "Conversion script deployed"],
      "steps": [
        "Run conversion utility ('CONVERT TO DELTA') on target Hive table",
        "Execute SELECT queries using legacy syntax via Tableau/Looker connections",
        "Compare schema definition pre- and post-migration"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Table converted successfully; schema unchanged; dashboards connect without errors and queries execute normally.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Validate ACID transactions maintain data integrity with concurrent writes",
      "description": "Simulate concurrent ETL jobs writing to the same Delta table to confirm transactional consistency.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Configured Delta table with transaction log enabled", "Multiple Spark write jobs prepared"],
      "steps": [
        "Launch two concurrent batch jobs updating records in Delta table",
        "Monitor transaction logs for conflict resolution",
        "Read final data snapshot and check for duplicate or corrupted records"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Delta transaction log maintains atomic consistency with no corrupted or duplicated records across jobs.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Validate time travel functionality with 30-day retention",
      "description": "Test Delta Lake time travel queries for historical snapshots up to 30 days and verify purging beyond retention threshold.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Delta table with historical versions available", "Retention configured to 30 days"],
      "steps": [
        "Execute SELECT query AS OF timestamp within past 30 days",
        "Execute SELECT query AS OF timestamp older than 30 days",
        "Attempt rollback of a Delta table version older than retention"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Data from valid timestamps is retrieved correctly; older versions beyond 30 days are purged.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Test query performance improvement with Z-ordering and compaction",
      "description": "Benchmark query execution times before and after applying Z-order indexing and compaction on top 20 queries.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Baseline query times captured", "Z-ordering script available", "Compaction enabled"],
      "steps": [
        "Run benchmark suite against unoptimized tables",
        "Apply Z-order optimization on designated columns",
        "Run same queries on optimized tables",
        "Compare execution times and storage utilization"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Query time reduced by >=50%; storage reduced by ~30%.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Verify Unity Catalog registration and access control",
      "description": "Ensure migrated Delta tables are registered correctly in Unity Catalog with proper access permissions and lineage tracking.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["Unity Catalog integration enabled", "Administrator token configured"],
      "steps": [
        "Run API endpoint '/api/catalog/register'",
        "Query registered tables via BI tools using non-admin and admin users",
        "Inspect lineage tracking logs for ETL data flow records"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Tables registered successfully; access enforced per user role; lineage captured accurately.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Validate unified batch and streaming data consistency",
      "description": "Test that real-time Kafka streams and batch ETL jobs operate on same Delta tables without data loss or query interruption.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Kafka stream configured", "Delta table supports structured streaming"],
      "steps": [
        "Start Kafka producer sending data to Delta target",
        "Run batch job to update same table concurrently",
        "Query the table during ingestion and validate completeness"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Streaming and batch operations continue smoothly with consistent and real-time queryable data.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Evaluate training workshop effectiveness for Delta Lake adoption",
      "description": "Assess training outcomes by verifying completion and performance of knowledge assessments post workshops.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Training sessions scheduled", "Test assessments available"],
      "steps": [
        "Conduct two workshops with the engineering team",
        "Collect feedback and confidence survey from attendees",
        "Execute knowledge assessment and calculate average scores"
      ],
      "expected_result": "90% of engineers report confidence improvement; average test scores exceed 80%.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "API Endpoint Validation - Migration Start and Status",
      "description": "Validate REST API endpoints for starting Delta migration and checking job status via Express controllers.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Node.js environment ready", "All services mocked"],
      "steps": [
        "Send POST request to /api/migration/start with valid tables list",
        "Verify 200 response with job_id",
        "Send GET request to /api/migration/status/{job_id}",
        "Verify job status contains correct progress and state"
      ],
      "expected_result": "API responds successfully with proper job start and status data.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Negative Test - Invalid API inputs trigger proper error handling",
      "description": "Confirm API rejects invalid requests and returns 400/500 errors appropriately.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Express server running"],
      "steps": [
        "Send POST request to /api/migration/start with empty table list",
        "Send POST request to /api/optimization/zorder with missing columns",
        "Simulate Databricks API failure in /api/catalog/register"
      ],
      "expected_result": "System returns correct error codes (400 or 500) and descriptive error messages.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Schema definitions for existing 500 Hive tables",
    "Sample ETL job configurations simulating concurrent writes",
    "Historical data versions for time travel validation",
    "Performance baseline metrics for top 20 queries",
    "Unity Catalog user roles and permissions dataset",
    "Streaming Kafka topics with realistic data payloads",
    "Training participant and assessment data"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Use Jest and Supertest frameworks for Node.js API unit and integration tests. Data migration and schema validation automated via Databricks notebooks tested using PyTest SQL assertions. Airflow DAG tests run via pytest-airflow plugin for orchestration integrity. Performance benchmarking automated using Spark job metrics and stored in test dashboards. CI/CD pipeline integrates GitHub Actions for test execution and reporting, ensuring fail-fast on migration or governance regressions.",
  "coverage_goals": "100% test coverage for REST API controllers and services; 90% coverage for data migration logic; performance tests covering top 20 queries; full validation of governance, access, and lineage; and time travel retention validation for all migrated tables."
}

{
  "summary": "The 8-week migration from Hive to a Delta Lakehouse on Databricks establishes a scalable, ACID-compliant architecture with unified batch and streaming analytics. The program promises 50% faster queries, improved data integrity, and 30% storage savings. Core deliverables include Hive table conversion, ETL modernization, BI dashboard continuity, and Unity Catalog governance—all planned within the existing $80K monthly compute budget.",
  "scope_overview": "Migration encompasses 500+ tables (200TB), 150 Airflow ETL jobs, and 50 BI dashboards. Deliverables include Delta conversion, ACID enablement, time-travel setup (30-day retention), Z-order performance optimization, and Unity Catalog integration to achieve consistent, governed, real-time analytics across Databricks Runtime 13.3 LTS on AWS.",
  "key_risks": [
    "Potential dashboard downtime during phased table conversions impacting business reporting.",
    "Query optimization may fall short of the 50% improvement target if Z-order columns are misidentified."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "QA reports strong readiness with automated tests covering API behavior, schema validation, concurrent write integrity, Z-order performance, governance, streaming resilience, and workshop evaluations. Staging mirrors production environment, ensuring comprehensive regression and performance validation prior to rollout.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Perform early profiling of query patterns to fine-tune Z-order column selection and ensure KPI achievement.",
    "Conduct phased migration using shadow tables and adopt a staggered dashboard switch to eliminate downtime."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Complete high-priority Hive-to-Delta conversions and validate key BI dashboards in staging.",
    "Initiate performance benchmarking and governance rollout via Unity Catalog before full production cutover."
  ]
}
